{{Version|2.2.23}}
[[File:Sell Button.png|frameless|left]]
Selling allows you to exchange [[Ores]] for {{Sprites|Gold Coin||x20}}, which can be spent on [[Upgrades]], [[Cards|Gilding Cards]], and [[Drones|Drone Points]]. Gold is lost when you [[Prestige]]. [[Drones#midasDrone|Midas drone suit]] is a great source of passive gold income. Bars that are crafted in the [[Craft|Craft Menu]] or dropped using the [[Bombs#tabber-Transmuter_Bomb|Transmuter Bomb]] cannot be sold.

{{clear|left}}
==Base Prices==
Base Ore sell prices.<ref name=disclaimer>Values were calculated using stats displayed in the game. There may be minor discrepancies due to rounding, but the values should not differ meaningfully from the true values.</ref> Sell price is affected by [[Stats#tabber-Ore_Sell_Price_Multiplier|Ore Sell Price Multiplier]].
